T-Mobile device.. Not for Verizon. Was supposed to be a verizon phone, I should have known better. Recieved a TMobile phone. That does not support CDMA. The only good part was the customer service. They processed my refund pretty quick, even though I had to pay for shipping to return it.

Excellent customer service from ReNew Pro's. Received a phone (Galaxy S10) that did not fit my cell service needs. I really hated having to send it back because it looked like an unused "new" phone. Quality, Service, and Price. They hit all 3 of my 5 Star buttons.

Phone arrived broken and seller refuses to issue a refund.. This phone arrived in the mail with a large crack in the screen. Total rip off. Arrived with a dead pixel and scratched screen. Seller (certified gadget's) would only issue a refund upon device return. Now selling same device for more. Total inconvenience. Buyer beware
Phone doesn't work. The phone is locked on a download screen and Samsung technical support said to return it

No email. I called Samsung again and they had no idea what I was talking about and no one should have told me that I was going to get a refund. Samsung needed to review the paperwork. Phone not working. iPhone is malfunctioning faulty Speakers are failing that are attached to display Can barely hear people on phone Phone tested at an apple dealer today Must be returned for a refund Told Amazon refurbished phones are generally not good! What a nightmare

Review on the seller name "Hybrid IT". I've had a great experience purchasing from this seller. I'll definitely work with the seller again. Had to Return. The speaker and blue tooth did not work. Had to return. The return process/experience with Buyspry was easy and efficient. I decided to get a refurbished Iphone X.

Didn’t work. Phone didn’t work and my service provider couldn’t fix the issue. However, the seller did refund me quickly, so thanks to them for that! It was probably just a faulty phone given that other reviewers didn’t have a problem. Oh well!

Apparent faulty facial proximity sensor from the first use.. Poor refurbishment; it appears that the proximity sensor was faulty despite the phone being approved by 'quality control'. All kind of interesting things were occurring on my newly refurbished iPhone 8 from the first phone call to all subsequent phone conversations. Another was purchased from a different refurbished and it works just like you'd expect an iPhone 8 to perform.

Do not buy from ReFoned. Do not buy from this seller (ReFoned) the phone they sent me stopped working after two weeks. Wouldn’t charge. Phone arrived not working, $6 to ship back. The phone arrived not charged and after 30 minutes of charging had 3% life and nothing would work on the phone. After getting in-person help from my carrier Cricket, they confirmed that it doesn't work and i need to return it. Unfortunately , then I had to pay $6 to return it because Amazon requests you print the label and box yourself.

Customer service. As described everything is good but after using it for 2 month the phone shutdown but the good thing is they accept the returns... the only good thing to buy on Amazon is no hassle...

Broken Phone. Received the phone and it would randomly turn off for hours on end and wouldn’t turn back on despite a full charge. Returned the product and the seller refunded only half what I paid for a broken phone. I’ve contacted them, but have yet to hear back.

Don't Buy From Woo. The phone sold to me was faulty and was repaired in such a way to hide it from the buyer. The battery was faulty and the phone would randomly restart, making normal use impossible. I contacted the seller (Woo) about the issue and they refused to help or take the phone back. Luckily Amazon is great and took it back and refunded me.
good experience. Phone arrived as described. Very happy with the experience.

Taking a chance with refurbished phones. They sent me a phone with a terrible battery,it gets hot and only lasts for maybe a half hour from fully charged,the print reader doesn’t work and the call reception sucks.I’ll change my rating when they rectify the situation!
The phone don’t work. The phone is stolen and can’t be hooked up are you bought it from a buyer that has a lock on it so no good

Your phone works great!. Thank you for this phone. I ordered 2 phones for my twin daughters who live in Belton, Tx. I am still trying to figure out how to help my 15 year old daughter return the faulty phone from other company. Now thanks to you my daughters at least have 1 working phone. Phone stopped working within 24 hrs. Within 24 hrs the phone malfunctioned and would not allow me to enter my code to access the phone. The screen was showing glitches, delays, and making noises . "We apologize for the inconvenience but we also found there to be no issue with the device there for the return reason was also invalid." Refurbished phone didn't work properly. The charging cord didn't work and I had to purchase one separately. Buyer Beware. Item not as described. As a matter of fact, it was almost invisible. Beware.

Q026.query: What experiences do buyers describe when seeking help or returning a faulty phone?

rows.text: I've contacted support 9 times (I counted), and they won't reimburse me the rest of the refund. Do yourself a favor and avoid these "Amazon Renewed" phones. They aren't worth the trouble.

Google does not support their warranty. The phone works great... until it doesn't. When the battery goes out, do not expect any help from the Google Store, even when it is under warranty. I purchased a pixel 4 XL in March of 2020. I had no complaints and everything worked well. Then around Christmas, the battery wouldn't hold a charge. No problem, it's under warranty... yeah right. Dealing with the Google store to support their warranty is a complete nightmare! No replacement phone, I've had over 5 people ask me the same question and none of them have delivered results so far. I have been without a phone for over 3 weeks. The battery malfunction is clearly covered by the Google warranty for new phones and Google refuses to replace the phone which does not have any cracks or water damage. I have completely lost faith in Google's product support.

Buyer Beware!. I purchased a new pixel 4a 5g phone from Xfinity Mobile and after less than 1 month, it would not charge. Google's warranty is either they will repair the 'lemon' phone or replace with a refurbished phone. After only 1 month, I can get a new 'used' phone to replace something that is brand new. Despicable! Don't purchase!

Google's customer support is the worst I have ever dealt with. My wife bought the 4a directly from the Google store. After about three months, there was purple bleeding that started appearing all over the screen. The phone still functions but you couldn't see anything besides purple shades. My wife contacted support and was told to send it in and it would be fixed under warranty. However, after they received it they went back on the warranty coverage. They said the phone screen was cracked (the phone has been in a case and has a screen protector). In the initial call to support we had sent photos of the phone to show the screen issue, none of which show any kind of screen crack. My wife requested photos of the cracked screen to which out agent "Irene" would not provide as it is in a different department.

Nightmare warranty process. Don't buy a Pixel.. Got this phone last fall and it was bricked by one of Google's own android updates a couple months later. I'm still trying to get them to make good on the warranty by either fixing or replacing the phone and it's been one of the worst customer support experiences I've ever had up there with Sprint and Uber. The support people are willfully unhelpful time wasters.

Phone stopped working. No help from Google.. The phone was decent when it was working. Nothing great, but ok. It broke a month after purchase and was repaired under warranty. Then it broke again and Goggle Support had me fed ex it to them, promising a replacement in 4-5 days. Two weeks later I still don't know if I am going to get a working phone from Google. Terrible, terrible customer support. I will never purchase a Google phone again. Worst phone experience I've had. **As an update, my claim has been denied and they are returning my defective, non-functional phone as is. I'm sureb many of the phones work, otherwise I would change my review to one star. I have filed a complaint with the B, and will seek other ways of shedding light on the terrible customer support and failure to fulfill their warranty obligations.

Stopped charging after 4 months. Amazon won't honor the warranty and gave a partial refund.. Great phone until it completely stopped charging after 4 months. Completely useless now. Contacted Google and directed us to contact Amazon since they are the seller and was advised that they would honor the 1 year warranty. Amazon insisted on only a partial refund. After two nights of back and forth, it feels like we had money taken away from us for a defective product. Not a good experience.

Don't buy it. Bought 2, both have been returned twice due to screens not working or camera issues. Google customer support sucks. They couldn't fix the phones both times and don't want to do a refund. Save your money

Past it's Prime. During a recent security update, my 8 month old Pixel 4a ($275) died. It could not see the sim card anymore. After 4 grueling hours in Google's warranty claim labyrinth, I finally had an appointment with you-break-we-no-fix. The guy at the counter says, I have a hairline crack that voids the warranty. Of course that is not true as the warranty specifically states: "If, in addition to a defect covered by this Limited Warranty, your Google Product also has damage which is not covered (for example, damage caused by normal wear and tear or misuse by you) then Google is only responsible for addressing the defect covered by this Limited Warranty". The good news is that I now have a decent pixel 4a webcam and a brand new Galaxy A53 5G ($349). The difference in these two phones is astounding.

BUYER BEWARE! Major issues after 6 mos with this phone - phone freezes, crashes.. Started getting error messages saying "network not available" - took it to my carrier & they suggested soft reset, which fixed but only temporarily. I would have to reset phone 3-4 times a day, never knowing when it would be working or not. Then new message appeared - "no SIM card emergency calls only" so carrier replaced SIM card, didn't fix the problem. Discovered on chat rooms this is common problem with Pixel 4a, called Google Support and since phone is under warranty, they said take to their partner IBreakUFix Store for repair. It's still there after a week awaiting authorization from Google for repairs. Both the repair store and I have called Google several times asking about this and they are NO help - the repair store cannot get them to respond.

Be advised. This phone has a 30 day warranty on it! my phone died after seven months and I just had to eat the $555.00. The seller has NO WARRANTY after the 30 day return policy, Google supposedly has a one year warranty, but Google has no customer service or any way to claim the warranty. A smart person would not buy ANY GOOGLE phone.

Amazon did give me a discount for wrong charger that came with it, but now that seems so minor. I am 10 days past refund, is there anything I can do for a replacement or a refund? UPDATE as of May 28 2021... STILL terrible problems with screen sensitivity. And Google even acknowledges it & keeps saying a fix has been sent in a Feb Update - Not on my Pixel 4a 5g. This phone, from what I have read, had some problems from the start, yet Google sold it as though it was a phone in working order. I for one think it should be recalled with the option of refund or replacement. My next phone will not be a Google Pixel I am afraid.
No customer support. Customer support is non existent. My phone quit working and I sent it back for repair and they have had for over 6 weeks with no response.

Camera dead after 3 months. Back camera unusable after 3 months, incredible lag. None of the "Fixes" from google work. My two options under the warranty? Send in the phone and have no phone at all while it's being repaired (estimated at 2 weeks) or drive 150 miles to the nearest UbreakIfix store location. If I have someone local repair the phone out if pocket it will void my warranty. Google support fails on this one

Phone was damaged and the money was not fully returned. I received the phone and when I turned it on there was a damaged in the screen. I sent it back immediately but I only got 50% of the money back. When I called Amazon customer service, they claimed this was issued by a third client and the only thing they could do was to write them an e-mail which resulted in nothing. I kept calling back for 3 months, but nothing was done. After 3 months they told me that the phone was no longer under warantee and that they coudn't do much. Only after telling them that I was recording the call and that I needed the full name of the person talking, they changed their mind and refund me the full amount. I would not recomend buying second hand Amazon products that come from third sellers (which was not even specified in the item- this phone is).

They said I couldn't talk to the specialist because the specialist couldn't communicate by phone, only email. So here I am two and a half months later, pissed off, and still have no new phone or my phone fixed when it is supposed to be under warranty for an entire year. Don't buy from Google, they don't uphold their warranty and make everything literally as difficult as they can. Safe yourself the time, energy and stress and buy anything besides a Google phone.

Do not buy the Pixel 4a. The phone overheats, the system starts shutting down. Camera, sound, etc. When receiving a call, the phone rings, however, the icon to answer bows not show up. Even when I have LTE on the screen, I measure it and upload is "0", download is a misery, and it gives me 78% package loss. Google service is a disaster. The made me spent several hours every day trying to troubleshoot. And now, 2 months and 3 weeks after I purchased it through Amazon at full price, Google says that since I did not buy it from them, they do not respond for the warranty of the phone. NEVER AGAIN! What is Amazon going to do with the warranty of the Pixel phones they sale? Do no buy it

Warranty is worthless. Do not buy phone. Their warranty service is completely worthless. My pixel screen died suddenly and I took to their contracted store ubreakifix who told me that this is beyond their capability to fix and they are not allowed to offer replacement phones. I mailed in my phone and I have been having one nightmare after another and I have het tobrecive a working phone back from them and it has been 5 weeks after my phone stopped working. Find a true phone company that know how to treat their customers properly like apple or Samsung.

Stopped charging around warranty exiration, seller refuses to fix. The phone looked fine at first, but a couple of months later it started having intermittent problem with charging. I reported to the seller and they said it can only be fixed if the problem is constant. A couple of weeks after the expiration of the 90 days warranty - charging stopped completely, and the seller refused to do anything about it (although the intermittent problem was documented). Waste of money, not worth the risk.

Anyway, no more Pixels for me - apparently the cheap price reflects such cheap components that the phones aren't reliable, and I need to have a working phone. NOTE: After a request to escalate the problem, multiple weeks, lots of emails, and two separate shipments for returns, Google fully refunded me for the original phone. I believe this is over and above what the warranty required, and so I've upgraded from 1 to 3 stars.

Q027.query: What do buyers say about support, warranty claims, or refunds?

rows.text: Already submitted feedback to Amazon to check out shipping delays coming out of Houston, as I have never had such delayed -- or "lost" -- shipments before, and two in a row of the same item. Dead in four months. Worked fine for almost four months and now won't boot. The description says this item has a US warranty which should be for one year. However, I can find no way on the Amazon site to return an order I have had for more than a month nor any way to get it repaired under the alleged warranty. Amazon customer service seems to service its' customers in a manner akin to a bull servicing a cow.

Terrible customer service from motorola.. Had a issue with the phone and motorola support was terrible. Customer agent was very rude and unprofessional and so was her supervisor. Secondly, he did ABSOLUTELY NOTHING to either address or resolve my problems with this phone. He is all lip service for appearance's sake so that Amazon customers will be duped into thinking that Motorola has good customer service. Part of his job apparently is to read Amazon reviews for this phone and answer them with some simple reply in order to mislead customers into thinking he/Motorola might actually try to help them. But, if you actually follow through and submit your Amazon review to him for resolution, he does NOTHING. Don't be fooled into thinking that Motorola cares about customer satisfaction. If you pay for this product and it has manufacturing defects that materialize after the first month or so, you will be out of luck and stuck with this GARBAGE phone. Motorola doesn't care about your satisfaction, only about your initial purchase, so that they get your money.

Buyer beware. Phone stopped charging after a year. It didn't fully stop charging, though--the phone can tell something is plugged in--it just charges about 1% per half an hour. Don't think you'll get good customer support or be able to get it fixed for less than $150, either. Not sure if you get a $50 discount for trading in your old phone and its components, or if the $50 discount is for being a customer.

Phone stopped working after 6 months. Buyers beware. Phone stopped working after 6 months and looks like their is no warranty... Was it a fraud product? Why no warranty. I didn't even realize their is no warranty being offered when i made this purchase. Disappointed
Doesn't perform as advertised. This g7 has issues. Shuts itself off a lot, built in Alexa does work even after talking with customer service.

Bad Phone for US. Camera died in less then 60 days of operation. Seller(Cellmigo) holds to a 30 day return policy, and since the phone is not warrantied in the US Motorola will do nothing for you. Amazon also states that their 90 day A to Z policy won't apply either(it seems useless to even have it in this situation). So buyer beware, you'll be out $300 and stuck with a useless phone. I'm pursuing other avenues to resolve this. I would avoid Cellmigo as a seller as well. If they offered to exchange it for a different phone I would feel otherwise, because they are selling a product with no warranty here(that would make them seem a fair seller to me, but their hands off approach tells me otherwise) I would be suspect of any item sold by them.

If one person got 4 bad phones in a period of less than 3 months, SOMETHING IS WRONG! DO YOU NEED A CLUEBAT? The G7 should be discontinued until it's problem has been resolved. Not to mention that it takes an act of congress to get a physical shipping label for people who don't have a printer! And you shouldn't assume that everyone owns one, which is also a poor business practice. Additionally, your customer service people are also clueless, and 90% of them CAN'T SPEAK PROPER ENGLISH! Your company has serious problems, but I doubt that Jeff Bezos gives flying flip!

Too Cheap to be worth it.. Overheats after 1 month. Screen acts up, battery does not last all day. Motorola customer service is terrible. Took me over a week to resolve. They sent me a like new replacement and it's just as bad 3 months later. Camara is not great either. This is one time going cheap was not worth it.

I finally called directly, and (after dealing with a surly customer rep) was transferred to the Warranty dept. The customer rep there was very nice, and after reviewing what I had submitted, said it was clearly under warranty. But when she tried to change the status, her system wouldn't let her do it. So she said she had to "escalate" it to the IT department, and assured me I'd hear back in 24-48 hours. Since then, my inquiries have resulted in "IT is working on it" and "they can't seem to verify the IMEI number." I even tried to ask if I could talk directly to IT, but was informed that the Warranty dept was the highest I could go by talking directly. And of course, they always thank me for my patience (ha!) It's now been 6 days and still no answer.

After going through basically the same steps and explaining the problem, the technician finally concluded that the problem was much bigger than he thought. He recommended I send back the two Moto G 7's as defective and get my money back. Motorola does have a no questions ask 14 day return policy. So this is what I used. The service technicians were all very nice and helpful. And yes, as you went to levels, each had more knowledge than the last. I'm pretty knowledgeable about computers and networking since I owned a Computer/Networking Services company for 25 years before I retired. I believed the problem was with the permission or authentication as I worked through this problem. The Level 3 Technician from Motorola agreed. One last comment... This problem was blogged about on the Motorola website back in February 2019. So other folks have had this issue.

I can't figure out another way to provide feedback about the delivery.... I used Amazon Chat for this, but doubt it will do any good. Maybe the vendor who lost the sale will work this from their side: This is the fourth Moto G7 I have ordered. I love the phone! There was a fantastic sale so I ordered one for another family member at an amazing price. Much to my chagrin, our lazy USPS worker returned a pile of stuff as "not deliverable." I hoped Amazon would honor the original price, but reordering did not keep the sale price. So I have canceled my order. I wish Prime users could block carriers that hire but do not fire incompetent people. Or reordering based on a "could not deliver" did not change the price. Maybe a bad rating will get escalated to someone who cares and can fix the system.

NOT Compatable with Ting phone Service.. NOT Compatable with Ting phone Service even though its unlocked and works on the other carriers etc. Still going to use the phone for some other things over WiFi. Will return to rate starts accurately once it gets some time in.

Excellent Amazon Return Policy.. I like Motorola phones. They have sharp and crisp screens. Unfortunately, the phone I received had a WiFi hardware failure -- that was the conclusion reached by Lenovo,com community support. Fortunately, Amazon has an excellent returns policy, fast and easy. Hardware failures are rare and Motorola is a good brand, usually high quality. The phone was manufactured in India.

I'm looking in to it and will update my review when I find out what's wrong . I may have to get a replacement after speaking with Amazon customer service, but it will be an insane inconvenience to have to set a new phone up all over again with my provider as well as all my accounts and phone settings which took a week . I can't really say much more until I know where the issue lies , but I've definitely been having issues since I got it . This phone is Tracfone branded . The other one I had , even though it was a demo , was not tracfone. It was just a Motorola phone sold from a Cricket store . I don't know if that is the issue ... if the quality is the same or not because they're sold or branded differently .

Good value considering features, function and form.. I am an old timer in the hand held phone world and have had many different hand handhelds and smartphones in the past including iPhone, Galaxy and LG. I am on my second Motorola. The only brand I WOULD NOT buy again is LG since I had multiple problems with that phone and found their customer service just plain disappointing. It is getting increasingly "me too" in the smartphone world and not not much meaningful differentiation. I paid $79 for my G7 during a promotion at BestBuy last summer.
International phone. I returned the phone. It was not what I wanted. (International, no warranty, directions in foreign language) . Return went smoothly.

TracFone Great Value. Before TracFone I had been paying Verizon 199 per month for two phones with their very snooty customer service. I changed to TracFone just to try them. They work better than Verizon and customer service is ok. I'm pleased.

The Amazon rep assured me that I was incorrect, and even if I was correct, he would not have the authority to help me.
